findings.claim: The current ten-owner crosswalk contains 25 mapping rows but only 23 distinct mapped external identities; 97 identities remain unmapped under the current authority surface.
Twenty-two current MajorRegion anchors have no direct identity mapping, but anchor non-mapping is a navigation diagnostic and cannot be interpreted as region-level coverage absence.

Physical & Material and Earth/Planetary/Space Systems currently contain zero directly mapped member identities, making them the clearest current-owner-set blank clusters without establishing whole-Ordivon untouchedness.

Computation/Computer Systems and Mind/Cognition/Language are the only MajorRegions whose three navigation anchors each have at least one direct identity-level mapping; this still does not create region coverage truth.

Mapped-neighbor/no-lift frontiers reveal a useful distinction between adjacency and field coverage: broad identities such as Philosophy, Biology and Software Engineering remain correctly unmapped despite mapped subspaces/neighbors.

Finance and Harness are authority-limited unknowns, not untouched domains; Host is external-mapping-weak, and Game is out-of-current-pilot-scope. These states must remain separate from identity unmappedness.
After bounded breadth saturation, the highest-information next work is frontier classification quality and owner-authority unlocks rather than further catalog expansion.
